title: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.21412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents now fix software, operate computers and serve customers, but their harnesses, the programs that run them, call a large LLM at every step, which makes long tasks slow and costly. Most of these calls end in a multiple-choice decision, such as which tool to call next. Decision models such as Jev answer these questions directly, at a fraction of an LLM call's time and price. We ask how a harness can delegate these decisions to a decision model with little loss of success. To evaluate decision models in agentic tasks, we build AgentDecisionBench, which tests them from isolated questions up to control of a running agent, on public benchmarks and our DecisionGym environment. The decision model most accurate on isolated questions solved only 69.5% of agent tasks, and without a fitted confidence threshold, delegating tool choices lowered success by 19.0 points. Building on these findings, we then design JevAgentH

translated_title: JevAgentHarness：对与LLM共享控制权的决策模型进行基准测试、部署与训练
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在能够修复软件、操作电脑并为客户服务，但它们的运行框架（即驱动智能体的程序）在每一步都要调用大型LLM，这使得长任务既缓慢又昂贵。这些调用中的大多数最终都归结为多项选择决策，例如下一步调用哪个工具。诸如Jev之类的决策模型可以直接回答这些问题，其耗时和价格仅占一次LLM调用的很小一部分。我们探讨运行框架如何将这些决策委托给决策模型，同时几乎不损失成功率。为了在智能体任务中评估决策模型，我们构建了AgentDecisionBench，它在公开基准和自建的DecisionGym环境中，从孤立问题测试到控制运行中的智能体，对决策模型进行全面评估。结果发现，在孤立问题上最准确的决策模型仅解决了69.5%的智能体任务，而在没有拟合置信度阈值的情况下，将工具选择委托出去会使成功率下降19.0个百分点。基于这些发现，我们随后设计了JevAgentH……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AgentDecisionBench基准与JevAgentHarness框架，让智能体运行框架将多选决策委托给低成本、高速度的决策模型以替代昂贵的LLM逐步调用，并通过置信度阈值机制在尽量不损失成功率的前提下大幅降低长任务的时间与成本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentDecisionBench and JevAgentHarness, which enable agent harnesses to delegate multiple-choice decisions to fast, cheap decision models instead of costly LLM calls, using calibrated confidence thresholds to preserve task success while significantly reducing the time and cost of long agentic tasks.
